timeline.text: The Rio Grande Southern Railroad reached Dolores.
Galloping Goose Motor No. 5 went into service on the Rio Grande Southern on June 8.
In April the Interstate Commerce Commission gave permission to abandon the entire railroad.
The Galloping Goose Historical Society built a replica of the original Rio Grande Southern Dolores depot.

sites.name: Galloping Goose Historical Society Museum
sites.season: May 22 through October 13; in winter open only for special events or by appointment
